description: This file contains unit tests for the onboarding remote authentication prompt features in a MacOS app, testing error handling, UI logic, and user interaction flows.

classes.name: OnboardingRemoteAuthPromptTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating various test cases for onboarding remote authentication prompts.

methods.name: `auth detail codes map to remote auth issues`
methods.description: Tests the mapping of GatewayConnectAuthError detail codes to RemoteGatewayAuthIssue enum cases.

methods.name: `password detail family maps to password required issue`
methods.description: Verifies that password-related error details map to a 'password required' issue.

methods.name: `token field visibility follows onboarding rules`
methods.description: Checks the logic for when the remote token field should be visible based on various onboarding states.

methods.name: `pairing required copy points users to pair approve`
methods.description: Ensures that pairing requirement issues provide correct UI copy and instructions.

methods.name: `paired device success copy explains auth source`
methods.description: Verifies the success messages and details for different authentication sources.

methods.name: `transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback`
methods.description: Tests whether probe feedback reset logic behaves correctly in different probe modes.
